question_patterns: 為什麼樹葉不是紅色的
first_sentence: 葉子是綠色的，因為有葉綠素。
facts: 葉綠素可以幫植物用陽光做食物
葉綠素吸收紅光和藍光，綠光大多反射出來
葉綠素變少時，葉子就會變黃

bridges.has_garden: 你家院子裡，有沒有不是綠色的葉子呀？

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: why do leaves have a green color
en.first_sentence: Leaves are green because they have green stuff inside them.
facts: The green stuff helps plants make food from sunlight.
It soaks up red and blue light, and bounces green light back.
When there is less green stuff, leaves turn yellow.
en.ask_back: Do you think plants make food from sunlight, or from sand?

bridges.has_garden: Have you picked a green leaf from a plant in your garden?
